function: Delay-Doppler channel estimation for zero-padded OTFS from received pilots, using a deep-unfolded ISTA network (CE-DU-ISTA) (pp. 2-6).
system: ZP-OTFS link with scalar signal model (no antenna array or RIS stated); 4 GHz carrier, 15 kHz spacing, 4-QAM, 500 km/h, M=N=32 to 128 (pp. 3, 8).
method: Model-based deep unfolding of ISTA, about 10-11 layers with learnable weights and soft thresholds, trained supervised with MSE loss on simulated pilot-channel pairs using Adam (pp. 5-8).
data_channel: Simulated EVA channel model with Jakes' formula generating the delay-Doppler parameters; 64,000 training and 640 test samples; pilot SNR drawn from -30 to 10 dB (p. 8).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same simulated EVA/Jakes distribution with random SNR; separate runs for M=N=32, 64, 128; no unseen channel, speed or grid test (pp. 8-9).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, ZBLB-OMP, ISTA, FISTA. Learned: denoising CNN (DCNN); generalization bounds also compared with ReLU and ADMM unfolded networks (pp. 8-10).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, NMSE versus layers and epochs, generalization error versus training samples, running time, complexity order (pp. 8-10).
complexity: Orders in Table III (p. 10): CE-DU-ISTA O(LNQ), ISTA O(TNQ), ZBLB-OMP O(T(MQ+MT^2)), DCNN O(TNQ^2+K^2NQC); inference 2.01 s versus ISTA 16.53 s (Table II, p. 9).
q1_support: p. 8: "The EVA channel model and" Jakes' formula generate the DD channel parameters; EVA is the standardized Extended Vehicular A profile (3GPP TS 36.101), not a TR 38.901 model, so the reviewer should confirm.
q2_support: p. 8: "The training and testing datasets are generated through mathematical" simulations from one EVA/Jakes distribution with SNR from -30 to 10 dB; Fig. 7 runs M=N=32, 64, 128 separately; no test on an unseen channel, speed, grid or pilot setting.
q3_support: p. 8: "algorithms, such as least square (LS), ZBLB-OMP, ISTA and" (non-learned); p. 8: "such as CNN. In particular, we adopted a Denoising CNN" (learned, same function, ref. [42]); NMSE compared in Fig. 8.
q4_support: p. 10: "the overall complexity of one iteration of CE-DU-ISTA" is O(NQ); Table III (p. 10) lists O(LNQ) for CE-DU-ISTA; Table II (p. 9) gives inference time 2.01 s versus 16.53 s for ISTA.
q5_support: p. 8: "mathematical simulations, comprising 64,000 and 640 samples, respectively" - data are simulated; no code or data link, DOI or public dataset appears in the paper.
notes: Area 4: OTFS channel estimation by deep unfolding. q1 rests on the EVA model (Extended Vehicular A, standardized in 3GPP TS 36.101, outside the TR 38.901 list), flagged for confirmation. The signal model is scalar with no antenna array or RIS (p. 3, Eq. 3), which area 4 admits. The abstract claims superior generalization, but p. 7 only gives a Rademacher bound and a test-set NMSE proxy, not a test in new conditions. Tables I to III were read from the page images (pp. 8-10).
